goal: Stop evicting mempool transactions purely by age to avoid dropping still-mineable transactions
Reduce per-entry memory overhead so nodes can fit more transactions within their mempool limit
agreement: Concept approval citing code cleanup and obsolete historical justifications (stickies-v, maflcko)
Unaddressed objection: wallet test no longer checks parent resubmission before child (fametrano)
Concern that unmineable transactions could linger and crowd out mineable ones under size limits (musaHaruna)
Prefer deprecating or raising the expiry threshold over immediate removal (ajtowns, musaHaruna)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because age eviction can drop mineable transactions like low-fee parents waiting on fee-bumping children
Removing the entry time index reduces per-entry memory overhead across the mempool
